package_info.package_versions: all versions after February 2024 (post-acquisition by Funnull)
package_info.why_malicious: After acquisition by Funnull, the CDN began serving modified JavaScript that injects malicious code into any website embedding it, redirecting users to spam/malicious sites and leveraging typosquatted domains for further attacks.

execution_context.trigger: import-time (when <script src="cdn.polyfill.io"> is loaded by the browser)
execution_context.file_location: Injected via remote script from cdn.polyfill.io, included in the HTML of victim websites

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At import-time, the browser loads and executes JavaScript from cdn.polyfill.io, which may include further requests to attacker-controlled or typosquatted domains, leading to user redirection or additional payload delivery.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The CDN, previously trusted, now serves scripts that perform unexpected and unauthorized actions, such as redirecting users and loading code from lookalike domains.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: A CDN-hosted polyfill script should only provide compatibility code for browsers, not perform redirects or load additional scripts from suspicious domains.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate CDNs serve polyfills or analytics scripts, but do not redirect users or load code from typosquatted domains.
key_indicators: Script loaded from a previously trusted CDN now performs redirection
References to typosquatted domains in loaded scripts
Behavior changes after domain ownership transfer

execution_context.trigger: runtime (when the malicious script is executed in the browser)
execution_context.file_location: Injected JavaScript from cdn.polyfill.io, referencing external resources

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the script loaded from cdn.polyfill.io fetches and executes additional JavaScript from a typosquatted domain (googie-analytics.com), which may further redirect users or perform malicious actions.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The use of a typosquatted domain (googie-analytics.com instead of google-analytics.com) is a classic indicator of malicious intent, aiming to deceive and deliver unauthorized code.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: A legitimate polyfill or analytics script should only reference official domains, not lookalikes.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate analytics scripts fetch code from official domains, not typosquatted ones.
key_indicators: Potential for user redirection or further payload delivery

execution_context.trigger: runtime (conditional execution based on user context)
execution_context.file_location: Injected JavaScript logic within the script served by cdn.polyfill.io

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: // Malicious logic: if (isAdminUser()) { /* do not execute */ } else { /* execute payload */ }
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the script checks if the user is an admin and conditionally avoids executing the malicious payload to evade detection and analysis.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Malware often includes logic to avoid execution in admin or analysis environments to evade detection and prolong its presence.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Legitimate scripts do not include anti-analysis or anti-admin logic.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Some scripts may check for user roles for feature gating, but not to evade detection.
key_indicators: Conditional execution based on user/admin detection

attack_chain.action: Website includes <script src="cdn.polyfill.io">, loading remote JavaScript.
attack_chain.leads_to: Malicious script is executed in the user's browser.

attack_chain.action: Malicious script from cdn.polyfill.io fetches and executes additional code from typosquatted domains (e.g., googie-analytics.com).
attack_chain.leads_to: User may be redirected or further payloads may be executed.

attack_chain.action: Malicious script checks if the user is an admin and avoids execution if detected, to evade analysis.
attack_chain.leads_to: Malicious actions are only performed on non-admin users, reducing detection risk.

behavioral_signatures: Unexpected redirects or script loads from websites using cdn.polyfill.io
Loading of JavaScript from typosquatted domains (e.g., googie-analytics.com)
Conditional execution logic to evade admin or analysis environments
file_indicators: References to googie-analytics.com or other lookalike domains in loaded scripts
network_indicators: Requests to other suspicious or typosquatted domains (e.g., kuurza.com)
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Scan website source code and network traffic for inclusion of cdn.polyfill.io and references to typosquatted domains. Monitor for unexpected redirects or script loads, especially from domains that closely resemble legitimate services (e.g., Google Analytics). Use web application firewalls or browser security tools to block or alert on requests to known malicious or typosquatted domains.
